title: C: String Manipulation
description: Implement string utility functions: uppercase, lowercase, reverse, and check if two strings are anagrams.

steps.title: String to Uppercase
steps.description: Write a function `void to_upper(char *s)` that converts all lowercase letters in a string to uppercase in-place. Test with 'Hello World!' and print the result.
hints: Subtract 32 from lowercase ASCII to get uppercase.

steps.title: String Reverse
steps.description: Write a function `void reverse(char *s)` that reverses a string in-place. Test with 'C Programming'.
hints: Swap characters at both ends and move inward.

steps.title: Anagram Checker
steps.description: Write a function `int is_anagram(char *a, char *b)` that returns 1 if strings are anagrams, 0 otherwise. Test with 'listen' and 'silent'.
hints: Use an int array of size 26 to count character frequencies.
Increment for string a, decrement for string b.
If all counts are 0, they are anagrams.
